reference: The lights were still warming up when the director shouted “action”.
sk: Svetlá sa ešte len rozohrievali, keď režisér zakričal „akciu“.
cz: Světla se ještě zahřívala, když režisér zakřičel „akci“.
acceptable: The lights were still {warming up|heating up} when the director {shouted|yelled|called|called out} “action”.
When the director {shouted|yelled|called|called out} “action”, the lights were still {warming up|heating up}.

mistakes.text: The lights were still warming up when the director was {shouting|yelling} “action”.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Krátky dej, ktorý preruší prebiehajúci dej, patrí do Past Simple: „shouted“, nie „was shouting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Krátký děj, který přeruší probíhající děj, patří do Past Simple: „shouted“, ne „was shouting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The short action that interrupts the longer one takes Past Simple: “shouted”, not “was shouting”.

mistakes.text: The lights still warmed up when the director {shouted|yelled} “action”.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Prebiehajúci dej v pozadí vyjadruje Past Continuous „were warming up“, krátky dej „shouted“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Probíhající děj v pozadí vyjadřuje Past Continuous „were warming up“, krátký děj „shouted“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The ongoing background action needs Past Continuous “were warming up”; the short action is “shouted”.

mistakes.text: The lights were still warming up when the director {shouts|yells} “action”.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej sa stal v minulosti, preto Past Simple: „shouted“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj se stal v minulosti, proto Past Simple: „shouted“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action happened in the past, so use Past Simple: “shouted”.

mistakes.text: The lights were still warming up when the director has {shouted|yelled} “action”.
mistakes.kind: Present Perfect instead of Past Simple
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri deji v minulosti s „when“ patrí Past Simple „shouted“, nie Present Perfect.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U děje v minulosti s „when“ patří Past Simple „shouted“, ne Present Perfect.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a past event with “when”, use Past Simple “shouted”, not Present Perfect.

mistakes.text: The lights was still warming up when the director {shouted|yelled} “action”.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Lights“ je množné číslo, preto „were warming up“, nie „was“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Lights“ je množné číslo, proto „were warming up“, ne „was“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Lights” is plural, so it needs “were warming up”, not “was”.
